name: Hypocrisy
overview: The Scriptures reveal hypocrisy as a form of deceit and hardened resistance against God's commands, exemplified in Pharaoh's repeated insincerity and obstinance. Despite acknowledging his sin and the righteousness of the LORD, Pharaoh continued to harden his heart and refuse to release God's people, demonstrating the danger of duplicity in one's relationship with God. This deceit contrasts with genuine repentance and obedience, highlighting the spiritual peril of hypocrisy.
